description: Vital Signs: Street Pavement Condition - by decade (Updated August 2018) is a dataset listed in Metropolitan Transportation Commission open data portal (data.bayareametro.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Metropolitan Transportation Commission. VITAL SIGNS INDICATOR Street Pavement Condition (T16) FULL MEASURE NAME Pavement condition index (PCI) LAST UPDATED August 2018 DESCRIPTION Street pavement condition, more commonly referred to as the pavement condition index (PCI), reflects the quality of pavement on local streets and roads in the region. Coverage: San Francisco Bay Area. The table has 4 columns. The portal shows 2018-08-21 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-bayareametro-gov-portal.
